source: https://piltoverarchive.com/api/external/v1/cards (paginated by page, header Origin: https://piltoverarchive.com; field card.super == "Signature")
notes: Riot's own gallery API (scripts/build-cards.mjs) carries no Signature marker at all — 0 hits — so this overlay is two independent third-party mirrors that agree by name, transcribed the same way data/legality.src.json transcribes bans: names only, resolved to base codes at build time.

Piltover Archive lists 51 Signature variants. dotgg lists 55 rows tagged Signature; the 4 extra are '<Name> (Spiritforged Nexus Night Promo)' rows (OGS-018-P, OGS-020-P, OGS-022-P, OGS-024-P) — the SAME four names (Tibbers, Highlander, Final Spark, Decisive Strike) reprinted under a promo code Riot's own gallery does not carry at all, not a 52nd Signature card. Names-only resolution collapses them onto the one base code each already has.

scripts/build-cards.mjs resolves each name to exactly one base card and fails loudly if a name resolves to zero or to more than one — verified by hand against data/cards.json on 2026-09-06: all 51 resolve to a single base, three are units (OGS-018 Tibbers, UNL-194 Shadow, UNL-196 Daisy!), four are Equipment gear (SFD-186, SFD-190, SFD-191, SFD-192, UNL-188 — five codes, four names since Ornn's three read as one row each), the rest are spells, and every one of the 51 carries exactly one champion tag.
